title: MIN of a column ignores BLANK
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( MIN ( V[N] ), V[Grp] = "A", V[Id] <> 3 ) )

source.quote: corresponds to the following MINX call
source.supports: MIN ( t[c] ) is MINX ( t, t[c] )
MINX skips blanks rather than reading them as 0

derivation: Group A without row 3 leaves rows 1 and 2, where N is 5 and BLANK. BLANK is skipped, so the minimum is 5 (reading BLANK as 0 would give 0 or BLANK).
